notes: Use a PRESTO or contactless card on the TTC. The UP Express to Pearson takes 25 minutes. For Niagara, take the GO train (direct in summer) or a tour.
Summers are humid at 25-30°C, with islands, beaches and festivals (Caribana in August, TIFF in September). Daylight lasts until 21:00.
CityPASS costs 130 CAD and covers 5 attractions. Museums cost 25-30 CAD, CN Tower 45 CAD. The 13% tax is not included in prices. Tip 18-20%.
St. Lawrence Market is closed on Mondays. Kensington is pedestrian-only on Sundays.
Poutine, peameal bacon sandwich, butter tart. The cuisine is multicultural (Chinatown, Little Italy, Greektown).
The island ferry gets very busy in summer. Book timed tickets online.

transit.name: PRESTO Card
transit.why_chosen: Works on the TTC subway, streetcars and buses, and on GO trains. A contactless bank card also works.
transit.where_to_buy: Metro istasyonları ve Shoppers Drug Mart; 6 CAD kart

stops.name: CN Tower
stops.tips: 553 m tower with a glass floor and the LookOut. Book online (~45 CAD) and arrive at opening to skip the queue. EdgeWalk costs extra.

stops.name: Ripley's Aquarium of Canada
stops.tips: Shark tunnel at the foot of the tower. Included with CityPASS.

stops.name: St. Lawrence Market
stops.tips: A market since 1803. Try the peameal bacon sandwich at Carousel Bakery. Closed Mondays.

stops.name: Distillery District
stops.tips: Victorian-era whisky distillery turned arts quarter, with galleries and Soma chocolate. Christmas market in December.

stops.name: Harbourfront Centre
stops.tips: Lakeside walk and canoeing. The islands look best at sunset.

backups.name: Cluny Bistro Distillery
backups.tips: French bistro in the Distillery District.

backups.name: Hockey Hall of Fame
backups.tips: Home of the Stanley Cup. An alternative to the aquarium.

stops.name: Jack Layton Ferry Terminal
stops.tips: The Centre Island ferry takes 15 minutes (~9 CAD return). Buy tickets online.

stops.name: Centre Island
stops.tips: Bike rental and the Centreville amusement park, with views of the city skyline.

stops.name: Ward's Island Beach
stops.tips: Quiet beach and cottages. Swimming in summer.

stops.name: The Riviera Ward's Island
stops.tips: Island cafe. Lunch with a view of the lake.

stops.name: Hanlan's Point Sunset
stops.tips: The western tip of the island: sunset and planes from the airport. Take the 19:00 ferry.

backups.name: Gibraltar Point Lighthouse
backups.tips: Lighthouse from 1808, said to be haunted. An alternative to the sunset.

stops.name: Kensington Market
stops.tips: Vintage shops, Latin markets and graffiti. Car-free on Sundays (May to October).

stops.name: Spadina Chinatown
stops.tips: One of Canada's largest Chinatowns. Come for dim sum.

stops.name: Rol San Chinatown
stops.tips: A dim sum classic. Open 24 hours.

stops.name: Art Gallery of Ontario
stops.tips: Gehry's wooden spiral staircase, plus the Group of Seven and Rubens. Free on Wednesday evenings.

stops.name: Graffiti Alley
stops.tips: Street art along Rush Lane, in Queen West.

backups.name: Seven Lives Tacos Kensington
backups.tips: Baja fish tacos. Expect a queue.

backups.name: Bata Shoe Museum
backups.tips: Shoe museum. An alternative to the AGO.

stops.name: Royal Ontario Museum
stops.tips: Dinosaurs and Libeskind's crystal extension. Discounted on Tuesday evenings.

stops.name: Yorkville
stops.tips: Upscale neighbourhood with shops along Bloor Street.

stops.name: Sassafraz Yorkville
stops.tips: A Yorkville brunch classic in a yellow house.

stops.name: Casa Loma
stops.tips: Gothic Revival castle with a secret tunnel and towers. Gardens open May to October.

stops.name: Spadina Museum
stops.tips: Edwardian-era house next to Casa Loma.

stops.name: Niagara Falls Table Rock
stops.tips: GO train plus bus takes 2 hours (or a tour for ~90 CAD). Stand right at the edge of Horseshoe Falls. Free.

stops.name: Niagara City Cruises Hornblower
stops.tips: Boat ride to the base of the falls (April to November). Ponchos provided.

stops.name: Niagara Parkway Walk
stops.tips: Riverside park. The Clifton Hill amusement strip is touristy.

stops.name: Table Rock Market Lunch
stops.tips: Dining floor with a view of the falls.

stops.name: Niagara-on-the-Lake
stops.tips: Victorian town and vineyards. Icewine tasting at Inniskillin. Take the WEGO bus.

backups.name: Inniskillin Winery
backups.tips: Icewine tasting. An alternative to the town.

backups.name: Skylon Tower
backups.tips: Tower overlooking the falls. Go here if the boats are closed.

stops.name: The Beaches Boardwalk
stops.tips: 3 km wooden boardwalk along the shore. Woodbine Beach, with swimming in summer.

stops.name: Queen Street East Beaches
stops.tips: Neighbourhood shops and cafes.

stops.name: Lady Marmalade Leslieville
stops.tips: Leslieville brunch. Expect a queue.

stops.name: Evergreen Brick Works
stops.tips: Park and Saturday market in an old brick factory. Walk the Don Valley.

stops.name: Riverdale Park East Viewpoint
stops.tips: The best free sunset view of the city skyline.

backups.name: Tommy Thompson Park
backups.tips: Artificial peninsula in the lake, good for birdwatching. An alternative to Brick Works.

days.theme: Queen West and a gentle farewell

stops.name: Trinity Bellwoods Park
stops.tips: Hipster park with white squirrels.

stops.name: Queen Street West
stops.tips: Boutiques near MOCA, and Ossington.

stops.name: Aunties and Uncles
stops.tips: Classic brunch diner for a farewell meal.

stops.name: Union Station UP Express
stops.tips: The UP Express to Pearson takes 25 minutes. Time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Museum of Contemporary Art Toronto
backups.tips: Contemporary art in the Junction. An alternative to Queen West.
